messages:
jen-b: heads-up: we plan to unpin feature flag `model-routing-v2` from 100% back to staged cohorts tomorrow during the 02:00-04:00 PT change window. posting plan below.

samr: quick q — is this an unpin or a rollback to v1?

jen-b: unpin -> we want to route 10% -> 30% -> 60% -> 0% (drain) across 30m steps. we are not reverting code, just toggling routing policy.

alina-ml: metrics to watch: 95th p99 latency across seq>1024, token error-rate, and embedding alignment score on the eval set. please add thresholds.

mike_ops: propose concrete thresholds: latency p95 increase > 150ms over baseline OR error-rate > 0.8% sustained for 10m => immediate pause + rollback to pin. also if embed drift > 0.02 we revert.

jen-b: agreed. adding rollout steps:
```
- t0: set flag model-routing-v2.cohortA=1 (10%)
- t0+30m: set cohortB=1 (30%)
- t0+60m: cohortC=1 (60%)
- t0+90m: set cohortAll=0 (start drain to v1)
- t0+120m: cleanup and pin back to v1 if issues persist
```

samr: can deploy-bot run the toggle and annotate each step with metrics snapshot?

deploy-bot: Scheduled action created by jen-b for 2025-11-18T02:00:00-08:00. Actions: toggle flag `model-routing-v2` cohorts, snapshot metrics, notify #incidents if thresholds breached.

kevin-pm: putting this in release notes: "staged unpin of model-routing-v2 to validate cost/latency tradeoffs; cohorts enabled" — link to RN draft: https://docs.redwood/release/2025-11-18/model-routing-unpin-draft

alina-ml: adding monitoring runbook snippet:
```
- Watch: /dashboards/model-routing-latency (p95/p99)
- Run eval: curl -X POST https://evals.redwood/api/run -d '{"suite":"routing-smoke"}'
- If threshold breach: run `./ops/ff-toggle rollback model-routing-v2` and open incident
```

mike_ops: Rollback CLI for the run: `opsctl ff set model-routing-v2 --pin v1 --reason "auto-rollback"`

samr: tagging infra on-call @mike_ops for the window. please be ready to escalate.

jen-b: also note: we will disable batching optimization for cohort traffic during the ramp to avoid conflating batching gains with routing effects. config snippet: `batching.enabled=false` for cohort flags.

deploy-bot: At 1769876643: Executing step 1/4 - enabling cohortA (10%). snapshot id=sn-20251118-1.

alina-ml: snapshot looks clean, p95 +20ms only. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: At 1769876843: Executing step 2/4 - enabling cohortB (30%). snapshot id=sn-20251118-2.

mike_ops: noticed small spike in tail latency. watching for 10m window.

deploy-bot: At 1769877020: Executing step 3/4 - enabling cohortC (60%). snapshot id=sn-20251118-3. Trigger checks: p95 delta 140ms, error-rate 0.5% -> below rollback threshold.

jen-b: continuing to step 4 unless we see sustained degradation. thanks all for standby.

kevin-pm: will send update to customer-facing list if we need to pin back.

mike_ops: if we hit rollback, recommend also throttling new sessions and enabling the emergency kill-switch `ff-kill-all` while we recover.

samr: noted. I'll add a short postmortem template to the thread in case we hit the threshold.

jen-b: done. summary: plan approved, thresholds set, deploy-bot will run toggles, on-call ready. will post final status after the window.

deploy-bot: Action complete. Final snapshot id=sn-20251118-final. No auto-rollback triggered."
